profile: Travel professional who plans, books and runs group and private trips, and stays the one calm contact while they run.

highlights.title: Travel consultant
highlights.text: About 30 private and group trips a year

highlights.title: 14 countries
highlights.text: Europe and Asia, most planned himself

bullets: Itineraries: about 30 private and small-group trips a year, from three-day city breaks to two-week tours with several stops, each built around the travellers’ pace, budget and interests.
Bookings: hotels, ferries, coaches, licensed guides and domestic flights, each confirmed in writing, entered in one shared trip file and reconfirmed with every supplier a week before arrival.
On the road: the single contact for clients and suppliers throughout each trip, by phone and messaging, seven days a week, with a written handover whenever a colleague covers a day off.
Changes: rebooks ferries, rooms and transfers the same day when weather, strikes or delays cancel a leg of the route, and tells every traveller of the new plan before they reach the next stop.
Trip packs: a day-by-day plan with addresses, contacts, transfer times and confirmations, sent a week before departure and printed for travellers who prefer paper.
experience.intro: Independent agency for private and small-group travel in Greece and abroad.

bullets: Passenger desk: bookings, seat changes and baggage claims by phone and at the counter, on two reservation systems, for a regional airline’s domestic and summer charter routes.
Disruptions: rerouted passengers onto partner flights during cancellations, arranged hotels and meal vouchers for missed connections, and kept the queue informed at the gate.
